we proposed a meta-learning based framework for 3D point registration, named as 3D Meta Registration.
We proposed a novel meta-learning based 3D point-cloud registration model, named 3D Meta-registration, which is able to rapidly adapt to a new registration task.
we propose a new approach to learn a 3D Registration Function Space, which enables us to predict 3D registration functions that can be quickly adapt to new point clouds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of 3D Point cloud registration.
the meta-learning of 3D geometric transformations for point clouds registration.
the meta-learning of 3D Registration Functions, and we believe this work will inspire future studies on meta-learning in the 3D domain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our proposed method, 3D Meta-registration, is able to learn the prior over the 3D point registration function space and thus enables fast adaptation of the 3d registration model to new point cloud pairs, which can be applied to a wide range of 3D applications such as autonomous driving and augmented reality.
our 3D Meta-registration model is able to learn robust 3D registration functions by learning the distribution of  3D registration function.
3D meta-registration is a novel and effective approach for learning robust 3D registration functions with deep learning, and it can be applied to various applications in computer vision.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new meta-learning framework for the 3D point-cloud registration problem.
3D point registration is a meta-learning problem that requires learning a prior over the 3D function space.
we propose a novel meta-learning based framework for the task of learning a general 3D point-cloud registration function space.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed meta-learning approach is able to learn the prior over the 3D point registration function space, which enables consistent registration of point clouds with significant 3D structural variation.
3D registration functions can be learned in a meta-learning manner.
meta-learning is a promising approach to learn a prior over the 3D point registration function space.
